reviews.text: I really wasn't pleased with my experience at all. Just another "get you in and out". My cat is having serious life threatening issues and I got no sympathy from anyone. The vet (Nassi?) didn't get his name. Was in and out and just said her teeth were horrible. Said what I needed to get done $, which I did for my senior cat. I didn't get the results back until I emailed twice and I only heard from assistants. I didn't get any explanation of the results so I had to ChatGpt them to understand what's going on with her. Will NEVER be back. Another transactional non-compassionate place.

After being dismissed by two previous vets, I found this clinic and it was my saving grace. The doctor's gut instinct and expertise was spot on and led us to seek out a specialist who finally confirmed what I suspected all along—that she did have issues to address.

Dr Kia is fantastic! He took great care of our little Cavalier during her spay surgery and sent a thoughtful text when done. I've found the front desk staff to be helpful and responsive. I also love the convenience of an online booking portal!

Dr. Nassi is highly knowledgeable, he is caring and honest and answers all questions and goes thoroughly over diagnostics and all concerns. He is an excellent Dr. and his staff is also kind and professional. We have had multiple dogs in his care through the years and recently he took great care of our little Maltese for his surgical procedures. We are so grateful to have the expert care of Dr. Nassi and his professional clinic and staff.
Great doctor we have taken multiple dogs to him over the years
Awful place.  Cold male receptionist. Dog died within a week. I wouldn’t step food in there.
An excellent vet and they also specialize in arranging international pet travel. My go to vet

I am writing this review to thank the reception staff, and especially Dr. Nassi, for being extremely kind, helpful, and compassionate during a very stressful situation.

My brother in law had recently moved to Canada, and his dog fell sick while still in the U.S. I was trying to figure out how to get the dog safely to Canada given his medical condition, and I called several clinics for guidance. Most places required an appointment just to answer basic questions, which made the situation even more stressful.

Dr. Nassi was kind enough to explain that if we were driving the dog to Canada, we did not need a medical certificate, which meant we did not have to wait for an appointment or go through a lengthy certification process. The clinic also reviewed and validated the rabies certificate over email without charging us.

As someone who does not own a dog and was trying to handle this on behalf of my brother in law, I was feeling very overwhelmed. Dr. Nassi really helped us understand the right path forward and made it possible for us to get the dog back to his owner.

I am extremely thankful for the kindness and support we received. I highly recommend this clinic. The entire team, including the reception staff, was warm, patient, and very helpful.

I started taking my kitty to this clinic earlier this year, and the experience has been wonderful. Dr. Kia is excellent — very caring, compassionate, and highly skilled. My kitty is older and has CKD, and recently he took extra time with her, made an accurate diagnosis, and helped her recover very quickly. I highly recommend him.
The service was excellent...I highly recommend the place and the people were very friendly...😍🥰 …
VERY KIND & VERY PROFESSIONAL doctors & staff. A FAVORITE 😻

Beverly Robertson Veterinary Clinic is an exceptional clinic that provides exceptional service for travel. Lupe, the Senior Health Certificate Coordinator, and Dr. Nassi, the owner and medical director, are professional, kind, considerate, and polite. They make the stress of international travel and health certificates seem seamless. Although we haven’t yet taken our dog, Kona, for her appointment, we eagerly anticipate our visit on February 12, 2026. I am confident in the care they provide, and considering their reasonable prices, I believe this service is worth it. I highly recommend this clinic and they are incredibly responsive.

I reached out to this clinic for an international health certificate while relocating my cat abroad and was quoted for several services that were presented as “required,” including costly add-on documentation and treatments.

After reviewing the USDA website and the destination country’s requirements myself, I learned that all that was actually needed was an exam, completion of the international health certificate, and documentation of an existing rabies vaccination. The additional services and paperwork weren’t required at all.

While the staff was responsive, optional services were framed in a way that could easily mislead pet owners during an already stressful process. I highly recommend double-checking requirements directly on the USDA website and asking for a clear breakdown of what’s truly required vs. optional. Doing so saved me over $500 in unnecessary add-ons. Just something to be aware of if you’re getting your health certificate here.
Good service. Was vet was great and professional. Thanks for you fast service.

I used Beverly Robertson Vet for my international travels. They are very friendly, never make you wait and very professional. Dr. Nassi is awesome and will do everything he can to get your pet on the flight with you!! Thank you!!

I hesitate to post a review of this independently owned and operated veterinary practice, because now they will be even busier. But they deserve it - the vets and their entire staff are magical. My dog had some serious health issues that were brand new, and Dr Kia was wonderful to my dog - and to me. I was very distraught, and the staff calmed me down. My dog was definitely more relaxed than I was! He got his treatment, delivered extremely quickly, and he is fine now. What a find, this great dog and cat clinic!

Dr Nassi very rude, out of controll temper,  yelling me.
No heart , not  nice
Dr. Nassi was very helpful and attentive with our cat's health certificate.

5 stars is not enough for this fantastic clinic.

This is the third vet I visited for my cat in LA and by far the best. I only wish I'd found it sooner. It is so clean and organized and very well run. The reception team are above and beyond helpful and Dr. Nassi is so friendly and knowledgeable.

I was travelling with my cat to the UK through Paris, so I needed them to give her the rabies vaccine and prepare both EU and UK health certificates.

My cat is VERY anxious and usually despises vet visits but the vet tech made her feel very calm and safe so the rabies vaccine went by a lot more smoothly than I expected. Every other vet has been cold or standoffish with us, but Dr. Nassi and team were all patient, welcoming and kind :) which made the world of difference to us both.

I then returned 10 days before my travel for the health certificates. These were delivered to my house 3 days later (received on a Saturday, no less). Dr Nassi and team kept me updated throughout the whole process.

All the paperwork was completed properly and accepted by both France and the UK.

I couldn't recommend this clinic enough for travel or general vet needs. If I need a vet in LA in the future I would not hesitate to choose Beverly Robertson Vet Clinic.
They issue International Health Certificate (international passport) for pets. Great service, and their portal makes it easy to book appointments and stay up to date with my dog's health

Took my cat here a few months ago. They gave her an anxiety medication that didn’t work. I called to get an estimate for a teeth cleaning, I was told on the phone that they would get back to me with an estimate. I texted the next day asking about it, they said they would send it when it was ready which doesn’t say anything about when. I texted bear their closing time “will that be today?” Then I get a call saying she will need another exam before a teeth cleaning then tried to schedule it. I said no, I need an estimate of the cost and she said she couldn’t give me one. Awful customer service. You lost a patient.
Super helpful and stress free. Staff is very professional. I got a health certificate to fly with my dog out of the country and they made it very easy.
My Girl is always well taken care of, which is much appreciated.
Beautiful and clean facility staff is good.
Excellent care for our senior citizen cat.  Recommend.  Not cheap, but not exorbitantly expensive.
Very professional staff

If I could give zero stars, I would. My experience with this veterinary clinic was nothing short of horrifying. I trusted this vet to care for my dog and perform a very aggressive surgery—full dental extraction, which cost me over $2,900. You would think with such an invasive procedure, there would be some form of follow-up care or post-op appointment scheduled. Shockingly, there was none.

Weeks after the surgery, my dog began struggling with swelling around her neck, fluid buildup in her abdomen, and breathing issues. I reached out with concern, only to be completely dismissed by the vet without them even asking to see her. They told me it wasn’t related to the surgery, which is baffling considering these symptoms began after the procedure. They even had previously acknowledged that she came in with swelling around her mouth—which they attributed to her bad teeth that were then removed.

If the swelling was due to the infected teeth and the teeth were removed, then how is post-op swelling in the neck, breathing issues, and fluid retention not at least worth examining? I did my own research and found that these are not uncommon signs of complications following such a major oral surgery.

As a professional, where is the empathy? Where is the protocol? Where is the care? Regardless of whether a specialist is needed, it is completely unacceptable that no follow-up was offered, no healing was confirmed, and that my concerns were brushed off without so much as a visual check-up.

This is not just a failure in medical care—it is a complete lack of compassion, professionalism, and responsibility. For the price I paid and the trust I gave, this clinic should be ashamed. I will never recommend them to anyone.
Very friendly and compassionate-high recommendation
I stopped in today just to ask some general questions about Intl Health Certifications and lady working the front desk was helpful even though they do not do that for exotics

They are not good at keeping appointment times. I scheduled a technician appointment for vaccines for 3:20 pm arriving on time on the date of the appointment. It was nearing 4 pm and they still had not called me. I asked the front desk what the delay was. They never at any time told me why my pet’s vax appointment was taking so long. And likely would not have if I had not inquired. My time is valuable, too.

They are not transparent about pricing until after the treatment was done either. I went in for two vaccines and they informed me that he was also past due for a booster for a previous vaccine. When I went to pay, I had to pay for 3 three vaccines and an additional booster at a later date.

Bottom line is that there is very poor communication regarding delays and pricing. I do not recommend them.

One of the most difficult aspects of moving, was having to leave Dr. Nassi and the BRVC team. Years ago they went above and beyond, day and day out for my senior dog Duke. My only regret was not having found them sooner. They took great care of him and I'm forever grateful. Couldn't recommend Dr. Nassi more.

I cannot thank Dr. Nassi and the team at Beverly Robertson Veterinary Clinic enough for the exceptional care they’ve provided to my beloved 16-year-old chihuahua. I’ve been to many veterinary centers over the years, and without a doubt, this clinic is the absolute best.

Dr. Nassi is truly one of a kind—extremely knowledgeable, thorough, and deeply compassionate. He took the time to explain my dog’s condition and treatment options in a way that was clear, thoughtful, and reassuring. He never rushed the process and made sure I understood every step, which meant the world to me as a pet parent navigating a complex health issue.

It’s not easy caring for an aging dog, but Dr. Nassi approached the situation with so much empathy and respect for both my dog and me. His genuine concern and calm presence helped ease my anxiety, and I left the appointment feeling more informed, supported, and hopeful than I had in a long time.

The entire staff at Beverly Robertson is kind, professional, and attentive. You can tell they all truly care about the animals they treat. The clinic itself is well-run, clean, and welcoming—everything you would hope for when entrusting your pet’s health to someone. Special shout out to Ryan!

After visiting so many different places over the years, I can honestly say that Beverly Robertson Veterinary Clinic stands out for its excellence in both medical care and heartfelt compassion. Dr. Nassi has earned my deepest gratitude and highest recommendation.

Dr Nassi is one of the best USDA accredited doctors in Los Angeles, his vet team completes all of our int'l health certificates for VIP pets traveling overseas. My company wouldn't be able to help these pets fly anywhere without his team.

My cat has had problems with allergies. So he needs those monthly shots. I called a mobile vet company and they charged me $600 Plus there were 2 women who were very nasty and rude and handled my cat in not a fun way.
Then I went to Beverly Robertson veterinarian clinic. They charged me $147 and took really good care of my pet. I am so impressed. So happy and as an added bonus when he needs an additional shot. I can just take him in for $65. And one of the technicians will do the injection. I am amazed. By all means, this is absolutely the place to go.

Dr. Nassi and his staff were absolutely fantastic in helping my dog get her health certificate for travel to St. Martin. From start to finish, he was incredibly responsive, answering all my questions about the paperwork with patience and clarity. The entire process was smooth and efficient, and I truly appreciate how quickly everything was handled.

They have helped us secure pet international traveling certificates for a very special maltipoo. They accommodated with multiple schedule changes and was a sport about it. The price is hefty , but these days what isn’t. Highly recommended for a no nonsense veterinary experience that can accommodate with Department of Agriculture and Livestock requirements for traveling domestically and internationally.
love this vet. very trust worthy, front desk is always nice. prices are reasonable. saved my cat from a severe case of FLUTD❤️
Reliable, professional and quick. I’ve been bringing my dog here since he was 4 months old and he is now 7 🙂 …
My kitty Lefty was spayed here. Dr Nassi did a great job. No problems!

Dr. Nassi and his staff are the best, to put it simply. He and the team have always been attentive and caring with my two cats, and Dr. Nassi has a great sense of humor as well. I love that this is my neighborhood Vet Clinic, and I think everybody would be lucky to have such an establishment around.
Dr. Nassi is an experienced veterinarian who is a caring individual as well. His staff are friendly and professional. Overall, I highly recommend his office.
I called this clinic to get a vaccine, but the operator didn’t explain anything to me and just hung up.

I had an incredibly disappointing experience at this vet clinic. My cat, who had stopped eating and drinking for two days and had a high fever, was in evident distress when I brought him in.

The only positive aspect of the visit was the kind front desk staff. Unfortunately, the rest of the experience was far from satisfactory. The male nurse was rude, loud, and showed a complete lack of empathy toward my cat's condition. Despite my request for a more considerate approach, his apology felt insincere and failed to address his behavior genuinely.

When Dr. Nassi arrived with a female nurse, they placed a towel over my already anxious and sick cat, covering his face. Although they did eventually remove the towel after I insisted, it only added to my cat’s distress and discomfort.

Additionally, when it was time to draw blood, I requested that the procedure be done in the exam room to reduce stress for my cat. Dr. Nassi refused, claiming it was for the staff's safety. This reasoning was particularly frustrating because my cat was so ill and weak that he couldn’t even open his mouth, let alone bite anyone. It felt like a flimsy excuse to avoid accommodating my reasonable request.

Overall, the lack of empathy, poor treatment, and dismissive attitudes from the staff were deeply upsetting. I will not be returning to this clinic and advise others to consider their options carefully before bringing their pets here.
Dr. Nassi is very nice and very knowledgeable! Staff is friendly and on point. Has been our clinic for over 5 years, very satisfied 👌🏻 …

My favorite vet ever. Outstandingly helpful, kind, and genuinely caring. Have helped us with everything from vaccines to rashes to nail trims to serious bone breaks. Pricing is very fair too, far cheaper than anywhere else we’ve been in LA. Could not recommend them more highly. Vets and staff are super communicative, much better than some of the other mid-city options. Great with record requests too!

You can come here knowing your pets will be taken care of by people that love animals as much as you do.
